name: service_bund_de-mcp
description: service.bund.de — Ausschreibungen (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The RSS view (jobsrss=true) of the tender search form, newest first, 100 results; `query` is the form's search field (templateQueryString, full text). category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent — ignore next_page. description is HTML with Erfüllungsort, Vergabestelle (buyer), Angebotsfrist (deadline) and Veröffentlichungsende; url carries a '#track=feed-callforbids' fragment.
